identity.issuer: Cascade Specialty Chemicals, LLC (Warehouse Supervisor Sandra Ortiz, trainer/evaluator)

scan.summary: This is the company's own roster of forklift and pallet-jack operator training and evaluations for the Portland facility, followed by one signed training certificate (Michael Chen, page 2). It lists three operators and the dates each was trained and evaluated. Rina Patel's three-year evaluation fell due on 2026-05-19 and is now more than four months overdue. The roster itself has not been updated since June 2, 2025.
scan.freshness_note: The roster was last updated June 2, 2025, about 16 months ago. It has not been updated since Patel's evaluation came due on 2026-05-19. Ask the Warehouse Supervisor for the current roster. If Patel has been re-evaluated since then, ask for that record too.

gaps.title: Operator re-evaluation overdue (R. Patel)
gaps.description: Rina Patel's most recent evaluation was 2023-05-19, and the roster shows her next evaluation due 2026-05-19. As of 2026-09-29 the document shows no new evaluation, so her three-year evaluation is more than four months overdue. The roster lists her as an operator of FL-2, the propane forklift.
gaps.fix: Keep Patel off FL-2 unless she is supervised until Sandra Ortiz evaluates her in the workplace. After that, add the new evaluation date and next due date (three years later) to the roster and issue a signed certificate. If she was already re-evaluated and it just wasn't written down, add the record now with the real date.
gaps.citation: 29 CFR 1910.178(l)(4)(iii), adopted in Oregon under Oregon OSHA Division 2, Subdivision N
gaps.locator: Page 1, roster table, R. Patel row

gaps.title: No certificate noted or attached for R. Patel
gaps.description: The Notes column says "certificate on file" for Chen and Rivera but is blank for Patel. The certification rule asks for the operator's name, training date, evaluation date and the trainer/evaluator. The roster row has all four, so the missing certificate may only be a paperwork gap. Still, the file has no signed certificate for her.
gaps.fix: When Patel is re-evaluated, issue a signed certificate like Chen's and mark it on file in the roster.
gaps.locator: Page 1, roster table, R. Patel row, Notes column (blank)

gaps.title: Rivera certificate referenced but not in this file
gaps.description: The roster says Jose Rivera's certificate is on file, but only Michael Chen's certificate is in this document (page 2).
gaps.fix: Attach Rivera's signed certificate (evaluation 2025-06-02) to this record, or confirm where it is kept.

gaps.title: Roster not updated in over a year
gaps.description: The roster was last updated June 2, 2025. It says no refresher training was needed in 2026 'to date', but that statement is only good as of June 2025. Nothing in the record covers the months since then.
gaps.fix: Review and re-date the roster, record any refresher training or new operators since June 2025, and update it every time training or an evaluation happens.
